get_datasets_and_dataloaders: get the dataset map and data loader map from an ImplicitronDataSource instance
create_implicitron_data_source: create an ImplicitronDataSource with a specified dataset map provider class type for Co3D data
pre_expand_imports: call pre_expand on ImplicitronDataSource to eagerly import all registered dataset and data loader providers
get_all_train_cameras: get all training cameras for a single scene from the ImplicitronDataSource all_train_cameras property
review_datasource_base: review the DataSourceBase abstract class and its get_datasets_and_dataloaders and all_train_cameras interface
